scripts.dev: npm run site-config && wrangler dev -c wrangler.site.json
scripts.deploy: npm run site-config && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c wrangler.site.json && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.site.json
scripts.db:migrate: npm run site-config && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local -c wrangler.site.json
scripts.demo:setup: npm run site-config && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/demo -c wrangler.site.json && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/demo --file=fixtures/demo.sql -c wrangler.site.json
scripts.demo: npm run site-config && wrangler dev --persist-to .wrangler/demo -c wrangler.site.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
